mechanism: Phenytoin induces CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, reducing haloperidol plasma concentrations and therapeutic efficacy, while haloperidol may inhibit phenytoin metabolism and increase seizure risk.
action: Monitor haloperidol efficacy closely; may require haloperidol dose increase; monitor phenytoin levels for potential toxicity; consider alternative antipsychotic with less enzyme interaction if feasible.
